text: Just as Awa was reaching for the wooden ladle, a cheerful cough sounded at the compound gate.
It was Moussa—Mor Lam's inseparable childhood friend, who possessed an uncanny sixth sense for boiling pots.
By the sacred laws of Teranga, no guest could be turned away without an overflowing bowl.
Mor Lam froze, horror dawning upon his face.
'If Moussa enters,' he hissed to his wife, 'half of my marrow is gone!
Tell him I have fallen terribly ill!
Tell him my soul is hovering near the threshold!'
